description: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §12. Window, dialog, and shell-open restricted to http(s). core:window:allow-destroy lets the window close itself after the user confirms leaving an unsent remote-folder edit behind (ADR-099); the close request is otherwise held. NO fs permission exists in this file, and the gate and CI reject a change that adds one here or inline in tauri.conf.json. The dialog opens files as well as directories; a file choice cannot be scoped. Three commands read outside the workspace root, each with its own guard, which is the thing to check rather than this file: pdf_extract (any regular file up to 32 MiB that parses as a PDF; only its text comes back), the token_file of sync_control_probe and remote_probe (a 0600 regular file holding one nt_ bearer of at most 199 characters, sent only to the origin being probed), and the same token_file read by the remote_* commands (ADR-099), sent only to the remote folder's configured origin. The remote_* commands write no local file; remote_list only hashes the local note at the same path, through the workspace root jail. Every other read and write goes through a command that validates the resolved path against the workspace root.
